decisions.reason: Because it extends the firm’s established automation offer in a growing industry and there is no sign of performance falling below aspiration levels, management would likely keep it while using available slack to build market acceptance.

As another close-to-core loading solution launched during expansion and investment, it is unlikely to trigger problemistic search soon unless early results disappoint clearly, so it would most likely be retained.

Although this dispensing machine is more distant from the firm’s established offer and therefore more uncertain relative to aspirations, the firm’s R&D orientation, current expansion, and the product’s visible recognition with a 2024 design award make short-term withdrawal less likely than continuation.
